name: Steptone & Son
type_description: Dual 555 timer square oscillator noise-maker (Atari Punk Console)
bom_parts_summary: 555 timers (ICs), resistors, capacitors, potentiometers; no ICs beyond 555s named
components_evidence: Page BOM lists component values and reference designators only, with no package/mounting annotations (no 0805, SOIC, DIP, TO-92, THT or SMD markers) - not determinable from page.

lineage.credit: Based on the Stepped-tone Generator designed by Forrest M. Mims III. Also known as the Atari Punk Console.
lineage.quote: based on the Stepped-tone Generator designed by Forrest M. Mims III

other_links: Related module category pages (555, Aggro, Oscillator)
notes: Two 555-based square oscillators, CV control on both, range switch, passive VCA, ext osc control. Page notes it doesn't track 1v/oct and sync isn't fully accurate.
